responsibility: Declares the common utility interface shared by collect2-like helper executables for process execution, waiting, signal setup, notices, and cleanup. In addition to exporting the collect_execute/collect_wait/fork_execute APIs and shared mode flags, it defines the contract that each tool must supply its own tool_name, tool_cleanup, and maybe_unlink hooks so the generic utility layer in collect-utils.cc can manage diagnostics and temporary-file removal consistently.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the collect-utils pair: it exposes the shared utility API, global mode flags, and the required tool-provided hooks like tool_name and tool_cleanup. Unlike gcc/collect-utils.cc, it does not implement execution or cleanup behavior; it defines the contract used by helper programs such as collect2 and lto-wrapper.
